messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — QBR scheduled for May 10. Need a short checklist and clear slide ownership. Goal: 20-min exec readout + 10-min risk run. Can folks confirm slide owners and highlight any onboarding/renewal blockers?

sam_csm: I'll own slide 3 (Onboarding status) and will pull update from the AtlasPay implementation notes. I think we still have the sandbox creds issue.

aj_engineer: noted. I can drop a short tech update (slide 4) about the sandbox and the hotfix ETA.

jess_ops: I'll handle the Runbooks & Enablement slide (slide 5). Need confirmation on which users need training and whether we have a recording. @sam_csm please share user list.

kyle_se: I'll do the cost/usage trend slide. Quick ask: what time range do you want — last 30 days or last quarter?

maria_cs: last 30 days will be better for execs. Also, renewal risk: CSM flagged "exec availability" risk for one sponsor — need backup exec or on-call for QBR. Can anyone reach out to the sponsor's EA?

sam_csm: I can ping the sponsor and try to lock an alternate date. If not, propose having VP of Customer Success present.

aj_engineer: ETA for sandbox fix is EOD Wed. I'll update slide 4 with "blocker cleared" if the patch lands.

jess_ops: We have a short enablement recording from last month — uploading to drive now: https://drive.redwood.ai/qbr/enablement-recording.mp4

maria_cs: thanks. Action items: 1) sam — confirm sponsor availability + share user list; 2) aj — update slide 4 with fix status; 3) jess — attach recording & bulleted training plan; 4) kyle — usage trend (30d) by Tue. I'll consolidate slides in the master deck by Thu COB.

kyle_se: ack — will have draft by Tue morning.

sam_csm: pinged sponsor via email. If no response by Wed, will escalate to VP. Also shared user CSV in #files.

calendar_bot: Reminder: QBR event created for May 10 16:00 UTC. Attendees: maria_cs, sam_csm, aj_engineer, jess_ops, kyle_se, vp_cs

maria_cs: perfect. Minor ask — include a 1-slide appendix with prompt set/regression checks (for the AI features). aj, can you add a short line about the regression test cadence?

aj_engineer: yep — will add one bullet: "weekly prompt regression + daily smoke tests".

maria_cs: great. I'll run a final runthrough Fri 10am. Everyone, please drop any slide links or blockers in this thread by Thu 5pm. :raised_hands:
